title: LLM Chat Request Builder with a Token Budget
instructions: In `chatreq.py`, implement `estimate_tokens`, `ChatRequest` (builder, `to_builder`, `to_payload`) and `ChatRequestBuilder`. `build()` validates the whole request, including a token budget that depends on the messages and `max_tokens` together regardless of setter order, and returns an independent frozen object.

evidence.label: A valid request applies defaults and renders a payload
to_payload() returns a fresh dict every call
A model and at least one user message are required
The system message must be first and unique
Temperature must be 0 to 2 and max_tokens at least 1
The token budget is validated at build() whatever the setter order
Builds are independent, frozen and store messages as a tuple
to_builder() pre-fills a new builder for copy-with-change
